title: Spectral degree
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be an orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ for the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with one basis vector equal to the constant-one function. Let its index set be finite and nonempty, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The spectral degree of $f$ is the supremum of the orders of multi-indices with nonzero Fourier coefficient.
hypotheses_covered: basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
